resources.string: The guest boots with ro.kernel.qemu=0 instead of 1, so firmware components take their real-device paths. Applies at the next full boot; switch off and reboot to go back to 1. Bluetooth may behave differently (the guest may try to start its real Bluetooth service), and host-to-guest clipboard sharing stops — that is expected, real devices do not share a clipboard; copying inside the guest is unaffected. Sound should not change: the media server keeps its private copy of the old value. Experimental.
